scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && node scripts/deploy.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc

DB.description: Stores inboxes, conversations, messages and settings. Choose a new database for this instance; migrations run automatically during deployment.

RAW.description: Private storage for original emails and attachments. Requires R2 to be enabled on your Cloudflare account.

AI.description: Workers AI generates drafts and classifies inbound email. Usage is billed to your Cloudflare account.

EMAIL.description: Outbound email. Enable Email Sending and onboard your sender domain after deployment; arbitrary recipients require Workers Paid.

DRAFT_QUEUE.description: Runs AI drafts asynchronously, with automatic retries. Use a queue dedicated to this instance.

DRAFT_DLQ.description: Keeps failed draft jobs after retries are exhausted. Use a separate queue dedicated to this instance.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth clients and tokens for the built-in MCP server at `/mcp`. Use a namespace dedicated to this instance.
